faqs.question: Are your recruitment services and work visas 100% genuine and legal?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely. 1991 Group operates under verified MEA (Ministry of External Affairs) accreditation in India and UAE MOHRE licensing in Dubai. All visas are direct employer-sponsored national work permits with biometric embassy attestation.

faqs.question: What is included with Europe agriculture and warehouse placements?
faqs.answer: Selected candidates receive an official Schengen National D Visa / TRC residency permit, employer-sponsored airline ticket, furnished accommodation, on-duty food or food allowance, comprehensive medical insurance, and full local transit.

faqs.question: Do I have to pay any advance hidden charges?
faqs.answer: No. We enforce a strict zero advance hidden fee policy. Documentation, interview, and profile verification are handled with complete contractual transparency from day one.

faqs.question: How long does the entire placement process take from application to flight?
faqs.answer: Gulf and UAE positions typically take 20 to 35 days from selection to flight departure. European Union (Poland, Romania, Germany, Hungary) work permits take approximately 30 to 60 days depending on embassy appointment schedules.

faqs.question: Can I visit your offices in person for consultation?
faqs.answer: Yes! Candidates and their families are welcome to visit our Corporate HQ in Al Mankhool, Dubai, or our India Operations HQ in Arilova, Visakhapatnam (Vizag) from Monday to Saturday during working hours.
